question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**gradually**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the dangers and consequences associated with forest fires.
 
• The appropriate adverb should indicate a manner in which the forests become littered with dry leaves and twigs.
 
• "**Gradually**" (धीरे-धीरे) fits well as it denotes a slow process, which aligns with the context of forests becoming littered over time.
 
• Other options ("**properly**", "**appropriately**", "**slightly**") do not fit the context of describing the manner in which forests become littered with dry leaves and twigs.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Properly (सही ढंग से): **"Properly" means in a correct manner.
 
• **Appropriately (उचित रूप से):** "Appropriately" means in a suitable manner.
 
• **Slightly (थोड़ा सा): **"Slightly" means to a small degree.
